Official 2024 announcement specifies tenure-track assistant professorship beginning September 2025; official EE 517 course description posted in the 2025/11 directory names him ECE assistant professor and coordinator; his CV explicitly lists current ECE assistant professor since 2025. Taken together they corroborate the start; exact effective day is not established.

findings.description: Soma appears on the official emeritus directory; its generic title is stale or ambiguous but there is no equally specific evidence of an active ECE professorship. Exclude as emeritus.

Zhu is not on the main directory, but the 2024 official announcement, later university course description, and CV together support current regular ECE appointment. The dated course URL is evidence of posting month rather than proof of exact effective day.
The two Ang Li entries have different profile URLs and are retained as separate identities.

Directory entries without person profile links use their category page as directory-entry URL. Vitaly Ablavsky’s captured affiliate entry links to https://corvidim.net/ablavsky, absent from supplied expected URLs; reconcile this difference.
